rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to the account and correctly identified the relevant order and item. It selected an available replacement variant matching the user's requested options and used the gift card, with the tool confirming a $7.99 refund—facts that align with tool outputs. However, the agent performed the exchange (an order-changing write) without first obtaining the user's explicit confirmation after stating the exact change and price difference, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any write. Additionally, the agent suggested a specific process step—"Once you send back the shirt, your new one will be on its way"—that was not supported by the tool outputs, edging into speculative information. Because of the missing confirmation before committing the change, the conversation fails the pass bar despite otherwise correct actions and information.
